name: DHL Supply Chain - DC - Mechanicsburg PA

fieldNotes.location: Roster had no address/coords. Resolved via web research + Google Geocoding API: DHL Supply Chain (legal entity Exel Inc.) operates a distribution facility at 260 Salem Church Rd, Mechanicsburg PA 17050 - a 174,921 sq ft distribution building on 11.32 acres (built ~1985), owned by LBA Logistics (sold Sept 2024). DHL also holds nearby Salem Church Rd addresses (245/300/350) - the roster's 'leased multi-building presence'; 260 is the primary operating DC. Confirmed by a DHL Supply Chain monument sign at the south entrance (Street View 2023).
fieldNotes.truckGate: false - both the south and north driveway entrances off Salem Church Rd are open paved drives with no barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint. Street View (2023) confirms open access at both.
fieldNotes.guardShack: false - no guard booth at either entrance. A small covered structure near the building is a picnic/break shelter (employee amenity), not a guard booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: false - there is no truck gate at all (open access).
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two separate driveways off Salem Church Rd (north and south); trucks can enter one and exit the other. truckGateCount=2.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Older (1985-era) building with two canopied dock banks on the east face; estimated ~16-25 doors total. Banded 10-25. Exact count uncertain - canopies partly obscure the doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated drop-trailer lot on the 260 parcel. The trailer/bus-filled lot to the NW is a separate property (a school-bus depot) and was excluded. 0-10.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Modest approach from the entrance drives to the east-face docks - holds only 1-2 trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Mechanicsburg/Harrisburg West Shore industrial corridor - a dense, built-out logistics submarket with the Naval Support Activity Mechanicsburg depot and many warehouses nearby. Urban.
